## 1. Test Command & Execution Instructions

To execute the complete BuildSafe SA automated test suite (including design tokens, information hierarchy, purposeful animations, and real-world end-to-end user workflows):

```powershell
cmd.exe /c scripts\with-node.cmd npm.cmd run test
```

### Execution Environment
- **Node Runtime**: v22.14.0 (`scripts\with-node.cmd`)
- **Test Runner**: Vitest v3.0.8 / v3.2.7
- **Test Configuration**: `vitest.config.ts` (Includes both `src/**/*.test.ts` and `tests/**/*.test.ts`)
- **Execution Mode**: Isolated in-memory execution, deterministic fixtures, zero network/database flakiness.
